Pretty fun and true to the Ridleyverse. It fits in somewhere after 3 and contains references to current timeline stuff and maintains some of the classic Colonial Marine lorebook stuff from back when. Voice acted too, none of the current text to speech stuff that passes for it these days.

Enjoyable, but it could be more. If someone gets access under the hood and makes everything more lethal, acid and melee. The difficulty settings turn everything into bullet sponges instead. I want to see them gain more agility, leaping wall-to-wall and making me waste ammo as the difficulty rises. Having to disable some of the special enemies with limb shots instead of them coming at you Terminator mode and tanking everything. All of the assets are there it just doesn't feel quite right currently.

The campaign mode is well done, but gets a little stale. It's not quite like Left 4 Dead campaigns where different routes are closed or open up sometimes. 

I'd like to see a mode where you get deployed to collect various specimens/objectives and then extract. Some of the current levels but barricaded differently or even current intel spots potentially could work with this. 

It has the potential to blow up in popularity if the right tweaks get made!

I've played Alien games since the 90's.  Focusing mainly on pc titles, I've played AVP, AVP 2, AVP 3, Colonial Marines.  How does Fireteam compare?  I'd rate it as pretty good.

Horde mode is broken though, because enemies can get stuck and softlock you.  So, it's not perfect.
Awesome game, very fun. Just need more players online and perhaps crossplay!

Great squad-based alien shooter.

Some key points:
It's [b]gameplay-driven[/b]. Plot, while present, is not the main focus here.
It's [b]coop-focused[/b]. If you choose to play solo you'll be given 2 A.I. squadmates - on lower difficulties they are [i]somewhat[/i] useful, but on higher difficulties they are of little help. Human teammates are recommended.
It's [b]grind-heavy[/b]. There's lot of levelling to be done here - character classes, abilities, weapons, etc.

Some pros and cons (subjective of course):

+ Highly addictive gameplay
+ Huge replay value - collectibles, unlockables, different character classes, etc.
+ Interesting plot, with major references to "Prometheus" and Alien lore in general
+ Funny, memorable characters

- Enemies on higher difficulties are absolute bullet sponges, which makes gameplay frustrating and boring. Seriously, if you don't have an idea for a high difficulty besides "let's give bad guys 10000000 hp", maybe don't make that difficulty at all? Not every game needs to have a "nightmare elite pro insane ptsd anal-rape" mode.
- Quick time events. I mean, really? What is this, Angry Birds?
